BridgeHandler.HandleInboundFrame(frame) - inboundPool.Enqueue(frame) - if full: sendTCPErrorResponseToConnection(...)
chan *config.Frame inbound jobs buffer = inbound.queue_size
worker goroutines startWorkers(inbound, inbound.worker_count) workerLoop() reads inbound jobs
InboundWorkerPool.process(frame) 1. subject := GetInboundSubjectForMessageType(frame.Type) 2. responseType := GetResponseType(frame.Type) 3. deadline := now + inbound.timeout

Current implementation detail InflightB is registered/removed for lifecycle tracking, but RequestWithTimeoutToSubject() returns synchronously, so ResponseChan is not the active rendezvous path in InboundWorkerPool.process().
runtime goroutines, channels and ownership
Shared State
Channels / blocking points
main goroutine - app.Start() - waits on sigChan - app.Stop()
metrics HTTP server goroutine - metrics.Start() - ListenAndServe()
collectMetrics goroutine - go a.collectMetrics() - 10s ticker (currently placeholder loop)
Inflight cleanup goroutines - InflightA cleanupLoop() - InflightB cleanupLoop()
Per endpoint connectionLoop goroutine - reconnect ticker - handshake - launches readLoop / pingLoop
Per ready TCP connection readLoop goroutine - reads bytes - deserializes Frame - invokes callbacks inline
Per ready TCP connection pingLoop goroutine - optional if ping_interval > 0 - idle timeout / reconnect trigger
tcp.Reader readerLoop goroutine - lifecycle only - waits for ctx.Done()
NATS callback execution context - QueueSubscribe callback for each outbound subject - Subscriber.handleMessage() - HandleOutboundRequest()
workerLoop goroutines: outbound - count = outbound.worker_count - blocks on outbound jobs
workerLoop goroutines: inbound - count = inbound.worker_count - blocks on inbound jobs
Important implication TCP request handling no longer runs entirely inline on readLoop. readLoop enqueues to inbound jobs, so backpressure is explicit at the queue boundary.
ConnectionManager / ConnMgr state - conn state machine - active connections - per-conn activity timestamps
InflightA map[tid]*InflightEntryA - stores subject/requestType/expectedResponseType/connectionID - waits for TCP response on ResponseChan - updated by processExternalRequest / handleTCPResponse
InflightB map[connectionID:TID]*InflightEntryB - request lifecycle tracking for TCP -> NATS
BridgeHandler shared owner - ctx / cancel - outboundPool / inboundPool - dependency fan-in
sigChan chan os.Signal buffer=1 main blocks on receive
outbound jobs chan *nats.Msg producer: HandleOutboundRequest consumer: outbound workers
inbound jobs chan *config.Frame producer: HandleInboundFrame consumer: inbound workers
InflightEntryA.ResponseChan chan *Frame producer: InflightA.HandleResponse consumer: sendAndWaitWithRetry select
ctx.Done() channels used by handler/workers/reader lifecycle for shutdown

TCP connection failover / failback cases (current source)
connection.PriorityConnSelector - HELLO-REQ / ACK(HELLO-RESP) 완료 후 READY 된 conn 중 가장 낮은 priority를 active로 선택 - ConnMgr.setState() 때마다 ReEvaluate()
worker.OutboundWorkerPool.sendAndWaitWithRetry() - priority 0..N 순회 - READY 아니면 skip - write error 또는 response timeout 시 다음 attempt / 다음 priority
worker.InboundWorkerPool.process() - 요청을 받은 원래 ConnectionID에 응답 전송 - failover 전송 없음 - sendTCPResponseToConnection()은 origin conn 이 HELLO/ACK 완료 상태(READY)여야 함
Case 1. write 시점에 단절이 바로 감지됨 1) active conn.Write() 실패 2) 같은 priority에서 retry_attempts 만큼 재시도 3) 계속 실패하면 다음 READY conn으로 이동 4) 성공 시 해당 conn으로 처리 지속

Case 2. write는 성공했지만 중간 단절을 즉시 못 감지함 1) conn.Write()는 성공 반환 2) 응답이 안 오면 response_timeout 대기 만료 3) 같은 priority 재시도 후 다음 priority로 failover 4) 이후 readLoop/pingLoop가 늦게 DISCONNECTED로 바꿔도 다음 요청부터는 새 active 사용

Case 3. 모든 conn 이 끊어짐 Outbound(NATS→TCP request/response): - 모든 priority가 NOT READY 이거나 retry 모두 실패 - InflightA.Remove() 후 replyError() Outbound without reply subject: - 전송 전에 reject + error log Inbound(TCP→NATS 응답): - origin conn not ready면 WriteToConnection 실패 - TCP 응답/에러 응답 모두 전송 불가

Case 4. 낮은 우선순위 conn으로 failover 후 상위 priority conn 이 다시 정상화됨 1) conn_0 이 HELLO-REQ 전송 + ACK(HELLO-RESP) 검증 성공 2) 그 다음 setState(READY) 3) selector.ReEvaluate() 4) active connection changed: conn_1 → conn_0 5) 이후 신규 outbound 요청은 다시 conn_0 사용 (failback)

Case 5. inbound 요청 처리 중 origin conn 이 끊어짐 1) TCP 요청은 conn_1에서 들어옴 → frame.ConnectionID=conn_1 2) NATS 응답 수신 3) sendTCPResponseToConnection(conn_1, ...) 호출 4) conn_1 이 HELLO/ACK 완료 상태(READY) 아니면 실패 5) 다른 conn 으로 우회 응답하지 않음

Case 6. background recovery ConnMgr.connectionLoop() - DISCONNECTED / CONNECT_FAILED 인 conn 만 5초 ticker로 재접속 - TCP connect 후 HELLO-REQ 전송 - ACK(HELLO-RESP) 검증 성공한 뒤에만 READY - ping timeout/read error 시 다시 DISCONNECTED
최종 응답 처리 요약
NATS→TCP RPC 요청 - 성공: TCP 응답 payload를 NATS reply로 반환 - 실패: all TCP connections failed or timeout 에러 reply
NATS→TCP reply 없는 요청 - request/response 브릿지 정책상 invalid - process() 초기에 reject 하고 error log 남김
TCP→NATS 요청 - NATS 응답 후 반드시 원래 ConnectionID로만 응답 시도 - origin conn down 이면 failover 응답 없이 실패 로그
